title: A noisy min-max game on trees
summary: We study a noisy version of a min-max type zero-sum game on the $d$-ary tree. Each edge of the tree is assigned an i.i.d.\ cookie, distributed uniformly on $\{+1,-1\}$. The game is played as follows: starting at the root, two players alternate turns in choosing a child to move to, with the game ending after each player took $n$ turns. Both players have full knowledge of the cookies on the whole tree. The cookies along the traversed edges are picked up and placed in a shared cookie jar.
